description: Search the CWI VERIFIED x402 service directory. Unlike self-registered indexes, every listing here was EARNED via evidence: a First Spin paid-run verdict receipt (we ran it, we paid, the receipt is the proof), a Needle Drop hash-chained attestation receipt (authorship, resolvable without trusting the directory), and the service's pinned /.well-known/x402 manifest (IETF draft-hawkins-x402-dns-discovery shape). Returns VERIFIED-ONLY results: service, provider, endpoint, x402 price (USDC/Base), evidence URLs, manifest URL, last-reverified date, and honest status (testnet_pilot vs live_mainnet — testnet is always labeled). Use BEFORE paying any x402 endpoint to confirm it cleared verification, or to find priced agent services you can call today.

max_price_usd.description: Maximum per-call price in USD, e.g. "0.10". Listings above this are excluded.

network.description: CAIP-2 network filter: "eip155:8453" (Base mainnet) or "eip155:84532" (Base Sepolia testnet).

query.description: Free-text search over service name, provider, and description (e.g. "playlist", "ledger", "catalog").

status.description: status=any includes testnet pilots and private pilots; testnet_pilot or live_mainnet narrows to one. Default: any (honest labels on every result).

verified_only.description: Always true — the directory contains only earned listings. Included so callers can assert it explicitly.

name: cwi_x402_directory_search
